# FQHESphereConvertSymmetrizedState

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereConvertSymmetrizedState`

```text
FQHESphereConvertSymmetrizedState, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereConvertSymmetrizedState [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --input-file : input state file name
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-state : reference state to start the Haldane algorithm from (can be laughlin, pfaffian or readrezayi3)
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    -n, --nbr-particles : number of particles (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -s, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -f, --fermion : use fermionic statistic (override autodetection from input file name)
    -b, --boson : use bosonic statistics (override autodetection from input file name)
    -r, --symmetrize : symmetrize state (instead of unsymmetrizing it)
    --apply-inversion : apply the inversion symmetric to a state rather than symmetrize/unsymmetrize it

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (removing any occurence of lzsym_)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
